service_roundtrip_ms.label: Device service response
service_roundtrip_ms.context: Background device service calls; not a Velair click or save.

interaction_ms.label: Switch between Overview and Schedules
interaction_ms.context: From clicking the tab until the requested Velair page is visible.

save_persist_ms.label: Edit and confirm one saved temperature
save_persist_ms.context: From editing a temperature through saving and confirming its stored value.

ha_event_loop_lag_ms.label: Home Assistant event-loop delay
ha_event_loop_lag_ms.context: Periodic delay readings during the activity window; whole Home Assistant instance.

browser_heap_bytes.label: Page memory (JavaScript)
browser_heap_bytes.context: Sampled JavaScript heap during the activity window; excludes the rest of the browser.

browser_task_ms.label: Page main-thread task time per sampling interval
browser_task_ms.context: Main-thread task-time deltas between browser polls, approximately one second apart; not operation latency or CPU percentage.

container_cpu_percent.label: Home Assistant CPU
container_cpu_percent.context: Sampled across the complete browser/load suite, including other integrations; Docker CPU can exceed 100% across cores.

container_memory_bytes.label: Home Assistant memory
container_memory_bytes.context: Sampled memory of the whole Home Assistant container across the browser/load suite.

browser_updates.label: Selected Velair component updates
browser_updates.context: Total during warm-up and activity; selected components only, not all Home Assistant rendering.

browser_long_tasks.label: Page long tasks
browser_long_tasks.context: Page tasks exceeding 50 ms during warm-up and activity; not attributed exclusively to Velair.

browser_long_task_duration_ms.label: Total time in page long tasks
browser_long_task_duration_ms.context: Sum of page long-task durations during warm-up and activity; not a response-time distribution.

browser_velair_requests.label: Page-originated Velair WebSocket requests
browser_velair_requests.context: Requests sent by the page during warm-up, activity and recovery; excludes the test harness's separate API connection.

browser_heap_after_load_bytes.label: Page memory after activity
browser_heap_after_load_bytes.context: One JavaScript heap reading at the end of activity; no forced garbage collection.

browser_heap_after_recovery_bytes.label: Page memory after recovery
browser_heap_after_recovery_bytes.context: One JavaScript heap reading after recovery; a difference alone does not establish a memory leak.
